canada.summary: A federal judge has thrown out a $1-million fine and foreign worker ban against a New Brunswick seafood processing company.

canada.title: Nanaimo-area teacher banned for life after pleading guilty to possessing child sexual abuse material

canada.summary: Experts say the changes, intended to address a mounting backlog of pending fatality inquiries, would reduce the number of deaths subjected to public scrutiny and bring a previously independent review process under ministerial control.

canada.title: Bargaining to resume between locked out Civic Centre workers and City of Corner Brook
canada.summary: The City of Corner brook locked out workers on Oct. 20.

canada.title: Lack of snow forces cancellation of World Cup giant slalom races in Quebec
canada.summary: Two women's World Cup giant slalom races scheduled in Mont-Tremblant, Que., have been cancelled due to a lack of snow, the International Ski and Snowboard Federation says.
